reason: A telemetry data-processing plugin that redacts supported credential values from outbound session telemetry copies before configured backends receive them, while preserving canonical session logs.

summaries.zh: 在会话遥测副本发送到已配置后端前，识别并替换支持的凭据和敏感值，而不改写规范会话日志。
summaries.en: Redacts supported credentials and sensitive values from outbound session telemetry copies before configured backends receive them without rewriting canonical session logs.

capabilities: Recursively redacts configured sensitive key values and recognized credential patterns
Applies a configurable replacement string to redacted values
Leaves canonical session logs unchanged according to the README
